title: A Lovász Theta Parameter and Theta Body for Signed Graphs
summary: We introduce a Lovász-type semidefinite parameter for balanced colouring of signed graphs. Its homomorphism target is a unit sphere equipped with an orthogonal involution: the fixed and anti-fixed components play different roles, while applying the involution to one endpoint realizes switching. The resulting parameter admits a symmetric formulation with two positive semidefinite matrices and an equally symmetric dual.
